shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files specs | sort | rg 'conversation|websocket' && printf '\\n--- dod ---\\n' && cat .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'cat src/transport/ws/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts && git show --stat --oneline HEAD && git diff origin/main...HEAD -- .lore/dod.md src/transport/ws/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && git status --short --branch'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "specs/.*#|@spec|SPEC:" src | head -35; rg -n "answers a list request" specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('src/transport/ws/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L7', 'src/transport/ws/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L17')
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/transport/ws/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md .lore/dod.md"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --stat && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git checkout -- specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md')
s=p.read_text().replace('src/transport/ws/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L7', 'src/transport/ws/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L17')
p.write_text(s)
PY
git diff --stat && git diff --check"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add src/transport/ws/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && git commit -m "test(transport): assert authenticated conversation list" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch && git rev-parse HEAD && git rev-parse @{u} && git log -1 --oneline'
